up: List all distinct molecules (their ChEMBL ID and preferred name) that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5665443. The document is identified from the docs table; molecules are linked via compound_records (doc_id). Only include molecules that appear in this document.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5665443';
